summary: The closure-sign bounds, strict constants, ball argument, disjointness argument, and localization of the exhibited slab subset are valid. However, the final statement overclaims that the entire positive-area set difference is contained in the three listed exact cells.
critical_errors: Let D=((P_0+H)/2)\(((P_0+E)/2)∪((P_0+F)/2)). The proof establishes only that S=((P_0+H)/2)∩{-1<f_j<0} has positive area and satisfies S⊆D∩(R_{\{j,k\}}∪R_{\{j,\ell\}}∪R_N). It never proves D⊆R_{\{j,k\}}∪R_{\{j,\ell\}}∪R_N, which is generally false: convex-hull bridge points outside the slab can be absent from both endpoint images while lying, for example, in R_{\{j\}}. Thus the final containment does not follow from the argument and fails under the natural set-difference reading of the statement.
